issues.title: BLU-044 CI sharding and dependency caching

criteria.reason: Shard partition parity is unit-tested, but cache correctness and runner restoration have not been demonstrated. The full AC remains incomplete.

criteria.requirement: Results are deterministic and reproducible; failures are explicit and actionable (partition contract)

tests.name: issue 600 AC-2 shard results are order independent
issue 600 AC-2 malformed shard inputs fail explicitly

criteria.requirement: No secrets, personal data, raw screenshots, or unapproved network egress in logs and artifacts

criteria.requirement: Backwards compatibility and cross-platform behavior reviewed with no unsupported capability advertised
criteria.reason: Cross-platform runner review and full-suite behavior are not proven by partition unit tests.
